name: PL0 demo loaded
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.actions();const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===4,150000,'demo steps');window.__p0=s;return h.json(s)})()

name: PL1 Catalogue Place capability arms the Generic Saw
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Catalogue');await h.until(()=>h.find('Generic Saw — Cut'),30000,'catalogue rows');const row=h.find('Generic Saw — Cut').closest('[data-slot=tree-row-content]');const btn=[...row.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='Place capability');h.ok(btn,'no place button');btn.click();await h.wait(2000);return h.json(h.steps())})()
